description: List the legal holidays for a year under FRCP 6(a)(6) and FRAP 26(a)(6): the eleven days in 5 U.S.C. 6103(a), the Friday observed for a Saturday holiday (5 U.S.C. 6103(b)(1)), the Monday observed for a Sunday holiday (Executive Order 11582), and the days the President closed the executive branch. These are the days a federal deadline rolls off. Each observed or closure day says which reading treats it as a legal holiday and that the point is not settled. State holidays are not applied.
name: federal_legal_holidays
title: Federal legal holidays for a year
